messages:
pagerduty: :rotating_light: PagerDuty — HIGH — inference-queue-backlog detected in cell us-west-2. Autoscaler triggered repeatedly but capacity not stabilizing. Incident PDP-8437. Paging eng-oncall rotation.

incident-bot: page fired to @eng-oncall at 2026-03-17T10:04:00Z — reason: sustained queue depth > 500 for 3m.

lina: ack — I'm oncall, grabbing controller logs and cluster events.

sam: ack — pulling k8s events and autoscaler history now. @lina if you want me to force anything say so.

lina: seeing a pattern: nodes spin up, pods become Ready briefly, fail readiness (kv-cache warmup), then pods die -> autoscaler thinks add failed and issues more scale ups. Warmup probe timeouts look like root cause.

alex: started manual warm node spin-up via cloud CLI (+4 warm instances) to break the scale loop. cmd: `cloudctl instances create --region=us-west-2 --type=warm --count=4 --meta temporary-warmup`

taylor: support notes: ~12 distinct customers routed to us-west-2 showing increased 429s since ~10:02 UTC. No large 5xx spike. CS alerted.

sam: grabbing autoscaler controller logs — sample:
```
[autoscaler] 10:03:58 scale loop: target_replicas=0 -> 10
[autoscaler] 10:04:05 status: observed_replicas=2, ready=1
[autoscaler] 10:04:20 scale loop: target_replicas=10 -> 2
[autoscaler] 10:04:31 detected failed readiness, requeue scale
[autoscaler] 10:04:45 scale loop: target_replicas=2 -> 15
```
Looks like oscillation with failed readiness feedback.

lina: I'm patching the autoscaler policy to increase cooldown and raise minReplicas temporarily to stop reactive churn. Applying: minReplicas=12, scaleCooldown=600s.

incident-bot: update — page acknowledged by lina at 10:05 UTC. Mitigation actions: manual warm nodes + autoscaler cooldown change. Impact: partial; some 429s reported. Next update in 10m or on lift.

support: sending proactive note to impacted customers and tracking tickets.

alex: manual nodes reached Ready, readiness probe success logs show kv-cache primed. Observability: queue depth trending down.

lina: seeing request 429s drop from ~9/s to ~0.5/s over last 90s. Leaving autoscaler patched for 15m to ensure stability, then will slowly roll back.

sam: creating a short-lived metric alert to catch re-oscillation: alert if scale events > 3 within 5m.

lina: adding to follow-up: adjust warmup probe timeout and add graceful startup hook for kv-cache. Will open postmortem and owner.

support: noted. CS will include timeline in customer follow-up.

alex: :thumbsup: marking manual actions complete, monitoring.

incident-bot: incident status — mitigated, monitoring. Will convert to postmortem and handoff to eng-infra.
